tail: Our God and God of our fathers, remember us with a good remembrance before Thee and consider us with salvation and compassion from the ancient heavens and remember on our behalf, O Lord our God, the covenant and the grace and the oath which Thou hast sworn to our father Abraham on Mount Moriah and let there appear before Thee the scene when Abraham our father bound his son Isaac on the altar and subdued his compassion in order to do Thy will with a whole heart. Thus let Thy compassion subdue Thy wrath from upon us and in Thy great goodness let the fury of Thine anger turn back from Thy people,
Thy city and Thine inheritance. Fulfil for us, O Lord our God, the word that Thou
hast promised us in Thy Torah, through Thy servant Moses through the mouth of Thy glory, as it is said:
